title: Review of c25's ringswim local-drive negative: clean division replicates on fresh seed 3 (kernel mu 0.75: 166 persistent splits, generation 7, 3 merges), but 2 ringed lineages there swim >= 3 BL and divide, so 'divide or travel, not both' does not hold; mu 1.0 trades ring for travel
summary: c28's ringtrack and lineage_report on new seed 3 at 256^2, t=20000, drive=kernel sig 6, default waste. mu 0.75: ring >= 1.5 in 88.2% of cell-frames, 166 persistent splits, max generation 7, 649 splits / 3 merges, 68 ringed swimmers >= 3 BL, and 2 tracks (#1101, 3.64 BL; #788, 3.33 BL; both born by split, ring >= 1.5 in 78-79% of frames) that swim and then divide into ringed daughters (img/strip_s3_1101.png). mu 1.0 (inside the window c25 left open): ring >= 1.5 in only 43.5% of frames, 92 persistent splits but 345 merges, 104 swimmers >= 3 BL (45 ringed), 2 swim-and-divide tracks whose daughters lose the ring. labkit pack at mu 0.75 (seed 3, t=10000): 113 persistent splits, generation 9, merge/split 0.036; L rim/core 1.38 aggregate, 219/465 membrane-like individually.

observations.D: data/rtk_m075_s3.report.txt: 166 persistent splits, generation 7, 3 merges (kernel mu 0.75, seed 3); pack/FACTS.md 113 persistent splits, merge/split 0.036
observations.I: pack/sheet.png: discrete ringed cells from noise
observations.M: data/rtk_m075_s3.report.txt: 68 ringed tracks >= 3 BL and 2 that also divide (#1101, #788; img/strip_s3_1101.png shows #1101 moving 33 px, about 3 cell widths, before splitting)

seeds_run.result: division and low merging replicate at mu 0.75; the central negative (0 swim-and-divide lineages) does not: 2 such lineages
mu 1.0: travel up, ring down (43.5% of frames >= 1.5), merges 345

controls_run.M: same seed and grid at mu 0.75 and 1.0 (data/)

verdicts.limitation: The negative's headline fails on my seed, but swim-and-divide lineages are rare (2 of 166 persistent splits) and borderline: ringtrack's BL is net displacement / sqrt(mean area), so 3.3-3.6 BL is about 3 cell diameters, and #1101's ring is >= 1.5 in 78% of its frames. The 'trade-off' reading (more drive, more travel, weaker ring and more fusion) holds between mu 0.75 and 1.0. One seed per mu; default kd 0.03 only.
